1.
None appeared to press this revision even in revised call.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by order and judgment dated 18.08.2006 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.2, Etawah dismissing the Criminal Appeal No. 24 of 2001 arising out of order dated 06.11.2001 of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Etawah in Criminal Case No. 85 of 1997 whereby, the revisionist has been convicted and undergone for two years rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs. 3000/- under Sections 7(1)(1)/16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and in default of payment of fine, the revisionist shall undergo three months additional rigorous imprisonment.
